title: Restriction sections on a contractible specialization neighbourhood
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V\to X$ be an affine object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site]. Assume $V$ is weakly contractible, meaning evaluation at $V$ takes every epimorphism of sheaves of sets on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ to a surjection, and assume every point of $V$ specializes to a point of $V_Z=V\times_X Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every abelian sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the component at $V$ of the unit $F\to i_*i^{-1}F$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] is an isomorphism $F(V)\xrightarrow{\sim}(i^{-1}F)(V_Z)$, natural in $F$.
